preconditions.description: The number of points n must be between 3 and 70.

preconditions.expression: len(stones) == 3 and all(1 <= s <= n for s in stones)
preconditions.description: There must be exactly three stones, each located on a distinct vertex from 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(len(colors[i]) == n and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz*' for c in colors[i]) for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: The color matrix must be symmetric with valid lowercase letters or '*' for each diagonal.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not is_solvable else True

postconditions.description: If a solution exists, output the minimal number of moves.

postconditions.expression: is_solvable and all(move in valid_moves for move in moves)
postconditions.description: Each move must be valid and connect stones with the same color diagonal.
